correctness.rationale: For each r-ary Boolean valuation, q=2^r colors encode atomic input minterms. Every graded-modal formula at a pointed equivalence class depends exactly on distinguished color c and truncated class-color counts t_i=min(K,m_i). All pointed types have depth-one characteristic formulas; nested D_j sees only a union of fixed colors per class, and the clamped count of such a union is determined by t. Types are realizable iff (no t_i=K and sum t_i is an actual class size s∈S) OR (some t_i=K and sum t_i<=M=max S), with t_c>=1. Therefore T(r)=2^{E(2^r)}, E/q=Σ_{s∈S}A_s(q)+R_{M,K}(q). For K>=2, deg A_s=s-1 with leading 1/(s-1)!, deg R<=M-K, so equality for infinitely many q=2^r recovers M and all S by maximal symmetric difference; for K=1 recover only M. Repeated class multiplicity is indeed invisible. Zero arity, M=1 and K=1 boundaries are included.
